rows.label: tlk70000013_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Did Popolo do something? It looked
like the chairman was scolding Popolo.

rows.label: tlk70000013_03_msg0002
rows.name:
That usual fit might happen again. I'd
better have plenty of sweet potatoes
ready.

rows.label: tlk70000013_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I don't mean Popolo is in poor health.
It's just an old habit.

rows.label: tlk70000013_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Popolo pilfers the chairman's
snacks when she gets angry
about something.

rows.label: tlk70000013_03_msg0005
rows.name:
But then the fear and shame set in,
and she always shows up here to
replace however much she stole.
